cost: Child grouping O(n); repeated construction/heavy scans can be quadratic at high degree. Each side degree k<=10 costs O(2^k*k^2) time/O(2^k*k) memory; k>10 greedy O(k^2), not exact optimum. Emission depth bounded201. u32 count arithmetic is unchecked.
description: Train tagged sentences into five side key levels and three Markov levels. left chooses first key with count>=3 and left>right; otherwise right. order groups heads clamped to n, recursively emits left subtree/head/right subtree. sort_side maximizes interpolated log-probability with subset DP for k<=10, greedy next-link for k>10. punctuate uses learned majority when known else structural rules.

inverse: An output ordering admits all tree/side/chain table states whose local choices emit it; many weights preserve the same order. PunctTable write/read recovers represented map state but malformed lines are skipped and duplicate keys overwrite. Order alone cannot recover original sentence order or counts.

Tied side counts cannot choose left. PunctTable total<3 or best*2<=total cannot override rules. OnceLock cannot be replaced by later set calls. order does not guarantee permutation for invalid cyclic/disconnected inputs or depth>200.
